action_proposals.description: A direct, one-stage push. The robot aligns behind the beans, descends, and pushes the entire pile into the target region in a single, continuous motion.

action_sequence.reasoning: Move the end effector from its initial position to a starting point directly behind the bean pile, preparing for the push. The target x is the bean pile's x, and the target y is slightly behind the pile.
Lower the end effector vertically to bring the pusher's bottom edge just above the table surface, ensuring it will contact the full height of the bean pile.
Execute the main push, moving the bean pile from its current location into the center of the taped target region in one smooth motion.

action_proposals.description: A two-stage push for better control. The robot pushes the beans to the edge of the target, then performs a second, smaller push to move them securely into the center.

action_sequence.reasoning: Move the end effector to align with the bean pile's x-coordinate and position it just behind the pile in the y-direction.
Lower the pusher to the correct height for sweeping, just above the table, to engage with the beans effectively.
Perform the first push, moving the beans from their starting point to the near edge of the blue taped target area.
Perform the second, shorter push to move the beans from the edge to the center of the target region, ensuring they are all contained within the tape.

action_proposals.description: A precision-oriented plan. The robot first makes a fine rotational adjustment to ensure the pusher face is perfectly square to the push direction before aligning and executing a direct push.

action_sequence.reasoning: Perform a small yaw rotation to perfectly align the pusher's flat face perpendicular to the y-axis, ensuring an even push as requested by the instruction.
After correcting the angle, move the end effector into position behind the bean pile, maintaining the new orientation.
Lower the end effector to the table surface to prepare for sweeping the beans.
Push the beans straight forward into the target region with the precisely aligned pusher face.
